Name: All The Weapons
Author: MGLXI
Description:
[size=6][b]ALL THE WEAPONS[/b][/size]

A collection of iconic pop culture weapons for Stardew Valley. weapons inspired by games, anime, and pop culture, with custom attack sprites, full translations in 12 languages, and shop availability at Marlon's.

[b]Version 2.0.0[/b] migrates the mod from Json Assets to Weapon Renderer.

[line]

[size=6][color=red][b]⚠️ IMPORTANT — READ BEFORE INSTALLING ⚠️[/b][/color][/size]

If you already have the old [b](JA) All The Weapons[/b] installed, you [b]MUST[/b] delete its folder from [font=Courier New]Mods/[/font] before installing this update.

[b]If you don't, SMAPI will detect a duplicate UniqueID and one of the two packs will fail to load.[/b]

[b]Steps:[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Close Stardew Valley.[/*]
[*]Open your [font=Courier New]Mods/[/font] folder.[/*]
[*]Delete the folder named [font=Courier New](JA) All The Weapons[/font] (or similar, it may appear as [font=Courier New]All The Weapons[/font]).[/*]
[*]Install this new pack in its place.[/*]
[*]Launch the game. Your weapons in inventory and chests are preserved.[/*]
[/list]
[b]The UniqueID is unchanged, so your save file is 100% compatible. You will NOT lose your weapons.[/b]

[line]

[size=5][b]What's inside[/b][/size]

This mod is a bundle that includes several sub-mods working together:

[list]
[*][b][[WR] All The Weapons][/b] — The main content pack. weapons with custom attack sprites at native size (24x24 to 48x48) and full translations in all 12 official languages.[/*]
[*][b][[AMF] All The Weapons Projectiles][/b] — Custom projectile sprites for weapons that shoot, using Advanced Melee Framework.[/*]
[*][b][[AMF] All The Weapons Special Attacks][/b] — Special attack effects for weapons, using Advanced Melee Framework.[/*]
[*][b][[ARCHERY] All The Weapons][/b] — Ranged weapons (bows, crossbows) using Archery.[/*]
[*][b][[CP] All The Weapons Animation][/b] — Multi-frame attack animations using Content Patcher and SpaceCore.[/*]
[*][b][ALL THE WEAPONS MECHANICS][/b] — Custom C# mechanics (dash effects, abilities, special behaviors).[/*]
[/list]
All sub-mods work together. If one of them fails to load, the rest will still work.

[line]

[size=5][b]Translations[/b][/size]

All weapons are fully translated into the 12 official Stardew Valley languages:

English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Russian, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Italian, Turkish, and Hungarian.

Each weapon's name and description adapt automatically to the language set in the game options.

[line]

[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install all required frameworks (see Requirements below).[/*]
[*]Extract the ZIP into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/font]. All sub-mod folders will be placed automatically.[/*]
[*]Launch the game. Weapons appear in Marlon's shop.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] — required[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/YOUR_WR_ID]Weapon Renderer[/url] — required[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] — required[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url] — required[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7886]Advanced Melee Framework[/url] — required[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16786]Archery[/url] — required[/*]
[/list]
